fire.caption: Painterly storybook illustration in gouache and watercolour on textured cold-press paper, with visible brush strokes, soft wet-edge pigment blooms and fine pencil linework, made as tall key art for the wrapper of an original trading card pack. No text, no letters, no logo, no border, no frame, no people and no creatures. A landscape of black basalt terraces under a warm amber sky, with glowing orange kiln mouths set into the rock and thin threads of heat shimmer rising from cracks. In the centre a large six-sided crystal of smoky glass floats above an ember-lit ledge, glowing from within with molten orange light and shedding a slow spray of sparks. Warm key light from the upper left, palette of ember orange, deep red and ash grey. The upper third of the frame is a calm, soft wash of colour with little detail, the main subject sits in the middle and lower part, and the edges fade into loose blotches of pigment.
